claim: Formulates score-based/noise diffusion generation as continuous-time reverse SDEs with equivalent probability-flow ODE dynamics.
claim_zh: 把逐步加噪/去噪的生成过程扩展到连续时间反向SDE及对应的概率流ODE。
innovation_detail: Formulates score-based/noise diffusion generation as continuous-time reverse SDEs with equivalent probability-flow ODE dynamics.
innovation_detail_zh: 把逐步加噪/去噪的生成过程扩展到连续时间反向SDE及对应的概率流ODE。
bottleneck: Discrete diffusion procedures and continuous score-based models previously lacked a unified formulation of reverse stochastic dynamics.
bottleneck_zh: 离散扩散过程与连续得分模型缺乏统一的反向随机动力学框架。
tradeoff: Continuous stochastic integration introduces solver and score estimation errors.
